context.body: Selected for the reader trail because “A scarlet robe, a crown, and mock homage” preserves a distinct core source unit within sentencing.

observations.body: The governor’s soldiers gather, clothe Jesus, crown him with thorns, mock his kingship, strike him, restore his clothes, and lead him away.
observations.label: A scarlet robe, a crown, and mock homage: textual observation

observations.body: The passage keeps jesus, soldiers, robe visible within its Crucifixion evidence.

payload.posture: Read Matthew 27:27–31 as its own sentencing and mockery crucifixion setting before carrying its language into another source.
payload.tension: The passage materially bears on the Crucifixion while leaving part of its motive, mechanism, or later significance unstated.
